prerequisites: For WGBAET: Successful completion of the modules required under the study plan in semester 1 and 2.

learning_outcomes.text: The course provides the basic competences for the assessment of energy efficiency in industry.
The students understand the role of industry in the overall energy system.
The efficiency improvement potential of individual cross-sectional technologies is known.
The students are able to estimate individual efficiency improvement measures, to classify them in the context of an integral energy system and to evaluate them holistically.

syllabus_topics: Energy efficiency in industry and manufacturing
Energy supply in industry and manufacturing
Load management concepts in industry and manufacturing
Importance of industrial and commercial energy demand for a successful energy system transition
Methods for the identification and evaluation of energy efficiency potentials
Possibilities for increasing energy efficiency in cross-sector technologies
Increasing energy efficiency in industrial and process engineering processes by linking thermal energy flows
Methods for quantifying heat recovery potentials
assessment_rules: The module examination (MAP) can be either a written examination of 120-180 minutes or an oral examination of 30-45 minutes. The credit points are awarded if the module examination (MAP) is passed. The module is weighted according to its credits (factor 1) for the overall grade.
